# Cross Dagger Solutions

> Veteran-owned consulting firm based in Colorado Springs, Colorado, serving clients nationwide. Business continuity planning, business impact analysis, risk assessment, tabletop exercises, training program design and fractional program advisory. Founder-led by Marcus Lolofie, a former Green Beret (15 years U.S. Army Special Forces, 21+ years service) holding the CBCP and CRMP (DRI International) and PMP (PMI).

## Services

- [Business continuity planning and business impact analysis](https://crossdaggersolutions.com/business-continuity-planning.html): critical services, tolerable downtime, dependencies and a continuity plan with named owners.
- [Risk assessment](https://crossdaggersolutions.com/risk-assessment.html): physical, personnel and operational risk, a scored risk register and a prioritized mitigation plan.
- [Tabletop exercise and after-action report](https://crossdaggersolutions.com/tabletop-exercise.html): a facilitated scenario with your leadership team and a written report of fixes with owners.
- [Training program design and instructor development](https://crossdaggersolutions.com/training-program-design.html): ADDIE-based curriculum, instructor development, assessment and selection design.
- [Fractional program and operations advisory](https://crossdaggersolutions.com/program-advisory.html): part-time program leadership, planning and decision support, exercise design and control.
